objective: Cut the CPU, memory and disk that a cluster's declared services use, without killing or restarting them more often, leaving any node short of disk, or leaving a synced folder behind.
invariants: only declared unit names, node short names and numbers are collected; no command lines, paths, environment or log text
an unmeasured service or node is counted as missing, never as idle
cpu is measured from cumulative cgroup counters over a stated window, never from one instantaneous sample
the tracked unit allowlist is the same on both sides of the comparison

stop_rules.condition: node_disk_free_pct_min is below 2 on any node: a file sync daemon stops near its free-space floor, so pause and free disk before measuring anything else.
service_kill_count rises beyond tolerance: a saving that gets a service killed (OOM, realtime limit, watchdog) is not a saving.
sync_folder_need_files_max rises beyond tolerance: trimming what a folder replicates must not leave a node behind.
resource_coverage_ratio is below 0.8, so the totals describe a subset of the declared services and a missing unit reads as a saving.
service_cpu_core_pct_total falls while service_rss_mb_total rises beyond tolerance, for example a poll loop replaced by an unbounded cache.

rollback.trigger: any invariant failure or stop rule
